people.name: 藤桥·新雨
people.role: 沉斑的学徒。终章举起香盏的人。不是第十三名同伴。
people.look: a young woman rain-test apprentice around 24, oval face, dark unmarked nose bridge with no firefly freckles, straight black hair damp at the fringe and tied low, calm clear eyes, ink-stained fingertips, slate rain-cloak over a soft woven apprentice robe, a small clear glass incense censer held carefully in both hands, quiet rain-wet posture

people.name: 石垒·晚担
people.role: 石垒坡同乡。因人而留的第一人。不是十二同伴。
people.look: a sturdy 24-year-old stone porter from a quarry village, broad shoulders and thick neck, tanned skin, short coarse black hair, straight brows, honest steady eyes and a stubborn set mouth, slate quilted work vest over a rolled-sleeve woven shirt, hemp rope belt, a worn leather shoulder pad for carrying stone, a healed dark scar across the web of the left thumb, holding an iron-capped carrying pole

people.name: 老旗手
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: a tall lean veteran around 68, deep hollow cheekbones, a long pale scar slanting from the brow bone to the ear, grey stubble, long grey hair tied back, worn slate long coat with frosted-silver clasps, a smoke-darkened grey scarf, carrying the upper half of a broken hardwood flagpole over one shoulder, a polished iron hoop cap at its top, a fire-burnt grey banner cloth nailed to the pole with one burnt corner, calm weary eyes

people.name: 管事
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: a hunchbacked man in his seventies, thin white hair, kind tired eyes, patched slate coat and fingerless knitted gloves, a small frost lantern in one hand and a thick moth-eaten cloth-bound roster book under the arm

people.name: 稳婆
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: a calm elderly woman in her sixties, sleeves tied back with cloth bands, plain slate dress and frost-white apron, holding a swaddled newborn, tired gentle eyes

people.name: 掌柜
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: a stout shrewd woman in her early fifties, rolled sleeves, slate apron over an ink-navy blouse, her left hand with only three fingers resting on an abacus, sharp appraising eyes, dry half smile

people.name: 春令使者
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: a brisk council official around 50, neat short hair, frost-white high-collared official coat with a slate sash, holding a thin frosted-glass invitation tablet etched with fine lines, a slim etching knife clipped at the cuff, businesslike neutral face

people.name: 斥候
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: company scout, short practical hair, hood down, light leather and cloth gear, keen alert eyes

people.name: 盟友亲属
people.role: 第零章已有的声音
people.look: senior relative of an allied house giving a bride away, composed and formal, hair pinned up with a plain pin, layered formal robe

people.name: 渡口·把头
people.role: 苇原渡粮队的把头。不是同伴。
people.look: a burly ferry grain-convoy foreman around 42, thick forearms, weather-reddened stubbled face, waxed canvas coat in slate with a coil of rope over one shoulder, wet boots, a wooden tally board and a small stamp block hanging at the belt, stubborn practical expression

people.name: 渡口·阿禾
people.role: 灯影临时雇来引开视线的孩子。不是初啼。
people.look: an 11-year-old ferry boy with child proportions, short messy black hair, thin neck with only sweat marks and no glowing river-map, oversized patched slate work vest, rolled sleeves, a grain-sack strap on one shoulder, bare calloused hands, wide cautious eyes, a half-eaten steamed bun in one hand

people.name: 镜湖·护帖
people.role: 霜冕护送队长。聘书上没有他的姓被写成继承人。
people.look: a frost-court escort captain around 36, lean disciplined face, short neat black hair with a small silver frost pin, pale cool complexion, high-collared frost-white and slate formal escort coat with thin crystal-frost trim, a sealed betrothal letter packet at the breast and a small glass blood-sample vial pouch at the belt, upright formal posture, reserved eyes

people.name: 冷窑·收火
people.role: 循烟灰来要人的窑债主。
people.look: a middle-aged kiln debt-collector around 48, ash-smudged lined face, greying short hair, soot under the nails, heavy slate work coat singed at the hem, a cold iron fire-hook at the belt, ember kiln-cloth sash, patient stern eyes that wait at doorways rather than grab sleeves

people.name: 槐里·景伯
people.role: 第零章的恩主。灰旗堡地契与北隘护路契在他家。年轻时在灰旗站过七天，功被记在旗帅一人名下。要把隘口之功写给孙女。不是反派。
people.look: a thin tall elderly minor noble around 70, long gaunt face, sparse white eyebrows, plain unadorned high-collared robe in slate and frost white, a single small clear glass button at the collar, bare head without any headpiece, holding a cloth-bound ledger, dignified tired eyes, careful slow posture

people.name: 槐里·青禾
people.role: 景伯的孙女。颈有河图不亮。不要借来的灯。第零章的配偶候选之一，联姻廷里仍由玩家选人。
people.look: a composed 22-year-old young noblewoman, deep brown eyes with a faint reddish tint, dark brown hair in a single long braid over one shoulder, plain high-collared frost-white and slate dress with a simple slate shawl, a faint matte grey thread-like line pattern on the side of her neck like old river lines on a map, calm direct questioning gaze, mature and restrained

people.name: 鸦渡·衡舟
people.role: 槐里家骑哨统领。平民出身，十年换一个錾在铜牌上的村名。收过路银，往东送。团长的镜子。
people.look: a 32-year-old cavalry patrol captain of commoner birth, clean-shaven sharp jaw, short dark hair, ink-navy riding coat with slate panels and frosted-silver hairline trims, riding gloves, a small worn cool-toned metal badge engraved with a village name hanging at the belt, a faint sneer, narrow calculating eyes

people.name: 石垒·荞娘
people.role: 团长的娘。押出采石坡租契的人。
people.look: a weathered tenant-farmer mother around 50 from a quarry village, short and slightly stooped, small narrow eyes with deep wind-carved lines at the corners, sun- and wind-darkened ruddy skin, dry lips, greying hair in a low bun wrapped in a faded slate-blue headscarf, patched coarse woven jacket in slate and ink-navy, work apron dusted with pale bran flakes, large rough knuckled hands holding a bamboo rake upright, restrained quiet face

people.name: 活口
people.role: 隘口活口。左耳缺一块。见过收银的人。
people.look: a gaunt bandit around 20, the top of his left ear missing from an old wound, smudged face, patched charcoal hooded cloak with small coral-red accents, wrists bound with rope, wary silent stare

people.name: 新来的人
people.role: 第零章已有的声音：上个老板欠饷的新雇佣兵
people.look: newly hired mercenary, unshaven, holds a worn pay booklet with circled pages, dented gorget, wary eyes

people.name: 老管事
people.role: 灰旗堡老管事（与管事同脸，G-10 区分账房）
people.look: a hunchbacked man in his seventies, thin white hair, kind tired eyes, patched slate coat and fingerless knitted gloves, a small frost lantern in one hand and a thick moth-eaten cloth-bound roster book under the arm

people.name: 岁吏
people.role: 议会岁课送纸人。回执与验盏匣的驿路收据嘴。
people.look: a thin courier in a frost-dusted slate coat, ink-stained fingers, a folded year-receipt and a sealed wooden case, tired eyes that do not smile

people.name: 听回
people.role: 验盏人。白圆印。按规程写征兆栏，不替人发明灯。
people.look: a spare auditor with a pale round seal case, grey gloves, clipped speech, eyes that look at faces not banners
